main-serve.title: Main Serve

oauth2.description:
OAuth2 / OpenID Connect authentication.
Supports two modes:
  1. Token introspection: validate externally-obtained Bearer tokens via userinfo_url. Endpoints use `auth: "oauth2"`.
  2. Authorization code flow (with PKCE): Main Serve redirects users to the IdP for login, exchanges the code for tokens, fetches user info, mints a Main Serve JWT, and sets it as an HttpOnly cookie. This bridges OAuth2 into the existing JWT auth model. Requires auth.jwt to be configured alongside oauth2.

Code flow endpoints (registered automatically when authorization_url is set):
  GET /_main-serve/oauth2/authorize  - redirects to IdP
  GET /_main-serve/oauth2/callback   - handles IdP callback

log_request_body.description:
Whether to log request bodies (can be verbose / contain sensitive data).
Bodies are logged at the DEBUG level. Bodies larger than 16 KiB are truncated in the log output. The body is buffered in memory for logging and then replayed to the handler, so enabling this adds memory overhead.

log_response_body.description:
Whether to log response bodies.
Bodies are logged at the DEBUG level. Bodies larger than 16 KiB are truncated in the log output. The response body is buffered in memory for logging before being sent to the client.

max_body_log_size.description:
Maximum body size (in bytes) that will be included in log output.
Bodies larger than this are truncated. Applies to both request and response body logging.

validation_schema.description:
Path to an external JSON Schema file for validating this column's JSONB value. The file is loaded and compiled as a JSON Schema at config load time.
Resolved relative to the config file's parent directory (same as `$include`).
Mutually exclusive with `validation` and `validation_schema_ref`.

validation.description:
Inline JSON Schema for validating this column's JSONB value.
The value must be a valid JSON Schema document (supports draft 2020-12).
Set to null or omit entirely for no schema validation.
Mutually exclusive with `validation_schema` and `validation_schema_ref`.

validation_schema_ref.description:
Reference to a named global schema (e.g., "global_schemas.my_schema").
Used to share a single compiled schema across multiple columns/tables.
Mutually exclusive with `validation_schema` and `validation`.

oneOf.description: No schema validation configured on this column.
External file JSON Schema for validation. Exactly one of the three validation fields must be set.
Inline JSON Schema for validation. Exactly one of the three validation fields must be set.
Global schema reference for validation. Exactly one of the three validation fields must be set.
